# Sherpa-ONNX C API header

`c-api.h` is the unmodified public header from the Sherpa-ONNX 2.0.2 Flutter
platform releases. It was taken from the macOS XCFramework published in
`sherpa_onnx_macos: 2.0.2`. The desktop speech bridge uses the matching Linux
and Windows runtime libraries. Update the header and package pins together.

Upstream: <https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx>

License: Apache 2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
